correctness.rationale: For each n>=2 and positive tau,kappa, the strictly interior unique optimizer solves a differentiable Lagrange system. The positive-semidefinite weighted-centering Jacobian has cross-norm equal to its maximum signed quadratic energy. Jensen concavity within a fixed sign cut, binary mass balance and cut-cardinality balance give the exact coefficient. Equality witnesses p_i=1/(2m) and 1/(2ell) exist as outputs. The same sharp coefficient is the reciprocal exact l1 strong-convexity modulus; continuity and uniqueness of extremal probabilities exclude distinct finite-score attainment. Independent standard-library checks pass 656 exact rational assertions for n=2..8; finite tests are supplementary, not universal proof.

value.rationale: The exact cross-norm modulus is an intrinsic robustness invariant for the natural Shannon-plus-quadratic convex probability predictor, fixing an optimal stability budget rather than merely verifying continuity. The odd-dimension sharpening rules out the ubiquitous uniform-probability guess; complete worst-case probability geometry and finite-secant nonattainment distinguish local from finite changes. This enables exact temperature/curvature calibration in the mixed regularization regime, without asserting any downstream model-performance result.
